summary: Regression testing after Capacitor plugin alignment (@capacitor/app@7.1.2, @capacitor/browser@7.0.5, @capacitor-community/privacy-screen@6.1.0) and AuthContext clanchat:// deep-link handler rewrite (App.getLaunchUrl cold-start + toast error surfacing). Since the deep-link code runs only under Capacitor.isNativePlatform(), the web app should be unaffected. Confirmed: 14/14 backend pytest cases pass, admin login->/feed in 0.42s, /admin route loads for admin, logout from /settings clears token in 0.04s and returns to '/', bob login->/feed in 0.36s, registration (TEST_reg_<uid>) reaches /feed with 'Account created' toast. No runtime-error overlay, no pageerrors. Only benign 401s on /api/auth/me pre-login and the pre-existing <span> in <option> hydration warning present.

issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Unrelated to this iteration but still unfixed.

critical_code_review_comments: Capacitor plugin versions are now aligned to core 7.6.8 (app 7.1.2, browser 7.0.5, privacy-screen 6.1.0) — good. Web build is unaffected.
AuthContext deep-link handler is guarded by Capacitor.isNativePlatform() so has zero web impact — confirmed by clean web regression run.

Cleanup fixture still missing: test_register_new_user + the playwright registration test each leave a TEST_reg_* user in Mongo (DB_NAME=clanchat). Add a teardown that deletes users with email prefix 'TEST_'.

Sidebar shows no visible 'Admin' link for the admin user (Feed/Search/Messages/Groups/Activity/Profile/Settings only) — /admin route still works via direct URL. Consider surfacing an Admin entry in the nav when role==='admin' for UX.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin login, bob login, register, /admin load, logout all pass)

seed_data_creation: One TEST_reg_<uid>@clanchat.app created via register flow (not auto-cleaned).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Capacitor deep-link/plugin change is native-only; web app fully intact. Preview: https://clan-chat-fix.preview.emergentagent.com. Register selectors: [data-testid='reg-email'|'reg-password'|'reg-handle'|'reg-display'|'reg-dob'|'reg-submit']. Login: input[type='email'|'password'], [data-testid='login-submit']. Logout at /settings -> [data-testid='logout-btn']. Onboarding tour appears for new/anonymous sessions — dismiss with text=Skip. Google/Supabase Android deep-link intentionally NOT tested (needs real device + Google account).
rca of the issue: No regression. Capacitor plugin downgrade only affects the Android build; @capacitor/core is untouched on web. AuthContext deep-link useEffect is wrapped in a Capacitor.isNativePlatform() check so it's a no-op in the browser. Both email/password (legacy JWT + Supabase-first fallback) auth paths verified end-to-end.
